title: Accor Warns Thailand: A Vietnamese Island Is Coming for Your Tourists
summary: Accor's Asia development chief says Vietnam's fast-growing tourism island could win over price-conscious tour groups that now go to Thailand. It means Thailand needs to rethink how it sells itself. Accor has a stake in both outcomes: 85 hotels in Thailand, and a deal for more than 1,400 rooms on Phu Quoc.

title: Heathrow’s Third Runway Has a $25 Billion Problem Before It Gets to Emissions
summary: The fight over Heathrow's third runway has been about whether it fits net zero. Lawmakers have now added a more basic question: who pays, and how much ends up in fares? Until ministers can answer that, and price in the cost of cutting emissions, the plan is stalled.

title: Houthi Attacks Gut Riyadh’s Peak Season
